notes.title: NEW MAP: Hospital + Emma Mini Rework 0.8.4
notes.content: [h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p] [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/j6sf1nQDsfk"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Added[/h2][list][*][p]New Map: Hospital. [/p][/*][*][p]Full customization catalog.     [/p][/*][*][p]A few new skins.     [/p][/*][*][p]Playable test version of the 2v6 mode! [b]EXPERIMENTAL![/b]     [/p][list][*][p]Currently, only random animatronics are working.         [/p][/*][*][p]The mode is not yet complete but is available for early testing to everyone!         [/p][/*][*][p]Requirements:         [/p][list][*][p]Open matches: Requires 8 players to start.             [/p][/*][*][p]Friends-only matches: Can be played with only 2 players.             [/p][/*][*][p]The first and second players will become animatronics.             [/p][/*][*][p]If the second animatronic leaves, the slot will become free.             [/p][/*][*][p]The next player to join (e.g., the 5th) will become an animatronic.             [/p][/*][*][p]Expect bugs related to the second animatronic.             [/p][/*][*][p]If two identical animatronics appear:             [/p][list][*][p]They might have identical skins or clothes.                 [/p][/*][*][p]This issue might also affect survivors.             [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Survivor team composition is random and can include:             [/p][list][*][p]6 Medics                 [/p][/*][*][p]4 Pointer[/p][/*][*][p]Or even 6 Supports             [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Changed[/h2][list][*][p]White message similar to "Need item" and so on...     [/p][/*][*][p]Forest and Factory are now available for HideNHunt (Game duration will be 10 minutes instead of 5 minutes.)     [/p][/*][*][p]The generator in the Forest will now remove items from the inventory after use.     [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced item image size, which should lead to faster image loading within the wardrobe. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p] [/p][h3][b]Survivors[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]SUPPORT:[/b] Cooldown after shot increased from 38 to 65 seconds.     [/p][/*][*][p][b]MEDIC:[/b] Cooldown after shot increased from 33 to 50 seconds.     [/p][/*][*][p][b]POINTER:[/b] Cooldown after shot increased from 48 to 80 seconds. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Animatronics[/b][/h3][h3][b]EMMA A-1[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ceiling:[/b]     [/p][list][*][p]You can now move on the ceiling, but it will be like a sprint.         [/p][/*][*][p]You can cancel this ability by pressing the right mouse button. (Will not consume energy and will not result in a delay).         [/p][/*][*][p]Landing cost from 5 to 15 energy.     [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Crawl:[/b] You can now cancel this ability by pressing the right mouse button. (Will consume half the energy). A sound is played when canceled. [/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]LAST RETAR[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Movement:[/b] Sprint speed from 570 cm/s to 535 cm/s.     [/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement:[/b] Walk speed from 325 cm/s to 335 cm/s. [/p][/*][*][p]Reverted Gas Bomb Killing Speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Gas Spray:    [/p][list][*][p] Time from 40sec to [b]65sec[/b].     [/p][/*][*][p] Use time from 5sec to [b]3 sec[/b].     [/p][/*][*][p] Cost from 40 to [b]25[/b].     [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]RK-1017[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Crawl:[/b] You can now cancel this ability by pressing the right mouse button. (Will not consume energy).     [/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown increased from 30 to 50 seconds.     [/p][/*][*][p]Jaw traps are now larger.     [/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with acoins.     [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in Episode 1 where EMMA A-1 was camping in the Generator Room.     [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where "You are visible" was displayed in matches, e.g., in the classic game mode.     [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with jaw traps where they still had the default skin.     [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with Last Retar where, during a jump, when the camera turned from first-person, boards no longer broke.     [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with survivors where they spent more bullets (e.g., support sometimes fires 4-7 bullets instead of 3).     [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the LAST update where biological waste clouds were sometimes dark.     [/p][/*][*][p]Temporarily fixed (we are not sure if this helps, we haven't had any problems since) memory usage during wardrobe crash / memory leak. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Nitrous Rework and more Patch 0.8.3
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][p]
---

[/p][h1]Added[/h1][p]
[/p][list][*][p] Head Bobbing.
[/p][/*][*][p] Many new Skins and Clothes for both Animatronics and Survivors.

### Changed

[/p][list][*][p] Police Station doors have new sounds.
[/p][/*][*][p] Animatronic Vision Color changed.
[/p][/*][*][p] Generator fixing Minigame is now less aggressive.
[/p][/*][*][p] RK-1017 Blind mechanic updated.
[/p][/*][*][p] NITROUS PM56-C some Animations updated.
[/p][/*][*][p] NITROUS PM56-C Dereflection sound updated.

[/p][/*][*][p] If Animatronics are falling for longer than 1 second, then on land they will make a sound.
[/p][/*][*][p] If the Animatronic is leaving Mid Match then the Survivors will still get their ACoins as reward.
[/p][/*][*][p] Episode 4 Boxes won't block the Flashlight/View from the player (the box location is a bit below now).
[/p][/*][*][p] Episode 4 Player Crouch speed from 100 cm/s to [b]175 cm/s[/b].

[/p][/*][*][p] Episode 4 Mr. Bite Reduced Hearing Range.
[/p][/*][*][p] Episode 4 Mr. Bite stun will hold longer.
[/p][/*][*][p] Episode 1 Hand Tablet Resolution.
[/p][/*][*][p] Episode 4 Lock pick is now like Episode 1.
[/p][/*][*][p] Bunker Map Changed Animatronic Spawn Locations.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
---

### Balance Changes

#### Survivors

[/p][list][*][p] **SUPPORT:** Fire Cooldown from 65sec to [b]38sec[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] **MEDIC:** Fire Cooldown from 50 sec to [b]33sec[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] **POINTER:** Fire Cooldown from 80 sec to [b]48sec[/b].
[/p][/*][/list][p]
#### Animatronics

**NITROUS PM56-C**
[/p][list][*][p] **Hand Attack:** Cooldown from 0.65sec to [b]1.30sec[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] **Dereflection:**
    [list][*][p] Time from 125sec to [b]90sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Can now be used while being stunned (Helpful against stunlocks if times are correct).
    [/p][/*][*][p] Now has a blue effect on the Camera.
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p] **Dash:**
    [list][*][p] Cost from 40 to [b]30[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Time from 120 sec to [b]40sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Hit box from 95 to [b]70[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] From insta kill to Qte Damage (Similar to a hand Attack, if you hit a Survivor via Qte, then in this Dash the Survivor will be One hit).
    [/p][/*][*][p] When a Survivor gets hit by it, they will be slowed down similar to the Jaw Trap.
    [/p][/*][*][p] Nitrous Cannot Attack for 5 sec after the Dash.
    [/p][/*][*][p] Hitting a Wall will make sound and effect.
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][/list][p]
**EMMA A-1**
[/p][list][*][p] **Ceiling:**
    [list][*][p] Cost from 20 to [b]45[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Time from 5 sec to [b]20 sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p] **Anti Overload:**
    [list][*][p] Default Stun from 9-10 sec to [b]7.5-8sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Anti Stun from 4.5sec to [b]2.4sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Time removal from mine and gun from 50 sec and 10 sec to [b]35 sec and 20 sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][/list][p]
**KESTREL 0-2**
[/p][list][*][p] **Disguise:** Time from 45sec to [b]50sec[/b].
[/p][/*][/list][p]
**LAST RETAR**
[/p][list][*][p] **Movement:** Sprint from 500 cm/s to [b]570 cm/s[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] Attack Range from 177 to [b]235[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] Gas Grenades now have a higher rate of killing.
[/p][/*][*][p] **Gas Spray:**
    [list][*][p] Time from 65sec to [b]40sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Use time from 3sec to [b]5 sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][*][p] Cost from 25 to [b]40[/b].
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][/list][p]
**RK-1017**
[/p][list][*][p] **Mine:**
    [list][*][p] Time from 70 sec to [b]65 sec[/b].    [/p][/*][*][p] Hearing Range from 600 to [b]700[/b].     [/p][/*][*][p] Piep Interval from 1 sec to [b]0.8sec[/b].
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][/list][p]
---

### Fixed

[/p][list][*][p] Fixed Jaw traps that did not slow down the Survivor.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Workshop music Volume if you turn lights off/on.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Match Starting bugs.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a Bug related to Friend Sessions.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Head Rotation bugs which cause head twitching like a fish.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a Bug with Donut Story, it will now be always 60 frames per seconds.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Story Mode bugs like Wrong Loading screen, Wrong Checkpoints and more.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Animatronic Stun Hit Collision.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed RK-1017 tail, it's now similar to Episode 4 MR. Bite.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a Bug in Episode 4 which after pulling heavy objects the pull mode gets disabled (its stamina) and then kinda still gets stuck in the mode half.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Wardrobe Interaction.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Story Emma Walk Sound Speed.
[/p][/*][/list][p]


[/p]

notes.title: PATCH 0.7.3 + Weapons Balancing
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we tested balance changes, and are sure that both sides are more fair now.
Survivor's gameplay is harder and more fun now, animatronics are harder to escape from.
You might have to change your playstyle as survivor characters, but don't worry, the changes are big only for pointer.
 We recommend you to don't waste too much stamina while animatronic is not close! This might save your life.
If you think the game is still unfair, contact us through comments or discussions on steam, and tell us your problems with current balance.

Here are the new cooldown stats:

Support: 35s > 65s
Medic: 30s > 50s, she has five mines now instead of four
Pointer: 45s > 80s

Now you might ask: Why is pointer's cooldown so big now?
He has easier qte, 2 chances of escaping animatronic's claws, more stamina and an ability, so his big nerf is fair.
Him having more stamina pays out in dealing with LAST RETAR (wolf animatronic) which will let him escape him easier, while not having 2 chances of escaping him with qte minigame.

That's all we wanted to say, enjoy your BALANCED out experience:)
